entities.summary: Siegfried Kracauer was a German writer, journalist, sociologist, cultural critic, and film theorist. He has sometimes been associated with the Frankfurt School of critical theory. He is notable for arguing that realism is the most important function of cinema. Siegfried Kracauer was a architects & engineers from Frankfurt (1889-02-08, Frankfurt–1966-11-26). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
